plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for BDCOM access device. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, and interface traffic, for BDCOM access devices and OLT (enterprise PEN 3320).
name: Access

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Control-plane CPU utilization from BDCOM-PROCESS-MIB. Prefer bdpmCPUTotal5min; if the 5-minute reading is absent, fall back to bdpmCPUTotal1min. Reported directly as a percentage.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Bytes in use in the BDCOM primary memory pool from bdcomMemoryPoolUsed. The primary pool is selected by bdcomMemoryPoolName (Processor), falling back to SNMP table index 1.

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free bytes remaining in the BDCOM primary memory pool from bdcomMemoryPoolFree. The primary pool is selected by bdcomMemoryPoolName (Processor), falling back to SNMP table index 1.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.query: (sum(device_memory_used{instance_type='access', name=~"(?i)processor", __$labels__}) by (instance_id) or sum(device_memory_used{instance_type='access', index="1", __$labels__}) by (instance_id)) / ((sum(device_memory_used{instance_type='access', name=~"(?i)processor", __$labels__}) by (instance_id) or sum(device_memory_used{instance_type='access', index="1", __$labels__}) by (instance_id)) + (sum(device_memory_free{instance_type='access', name=~"(?i)processor", __$labels__}) by (instance_id) or sum(device_memory_free{instance_type='access', index="1", __$labels__}) by (instance_id))) * 100
metrics.description: Primary memory-pool utilization of the BDCOM access device, computed as used / (used + free) * 100 from bdcomMemoryPoolUsed and bdcomMemoryPoolFree.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Optional chassis temperature from BDCOM-SYS bdenvTestPt1Measure, reported in degrees Celsius. Devices that do not expose this object simply omit the metric.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: device_total_incoming_traffic
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of total bytes received by the entire device over the past 5 minutes, summed from IF-MIB inbound octet counters (prefer 64-bit ifHCInOctets).

metrics.name: device_total_outgoing_traffic
metrics.description: This metric represents the average rate of total bytes sent by the entire device over the past 5 minutes, summed from IF-MIB outbound octet counters (prefer 64-bit ifHCOutOctets).

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart, derived from IF-MIB sysUpTime.
